Interface UserAccessTokenJpaRepository

All Superinterfaces:
BaseRepositoryCustom<UserAccessToken>, org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<UserAccessToken, Integer>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<UserAccessToken, Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<UserAccessToken, Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<UserAccessToken, Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<UserAccessToken, Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<UserAccessToken>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<UserAccessToken, Integer>, UserAccessTokenJpaRepositoryCustom
public interface UserAccessTokenJpaRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<UserAccessToken, Integer>, UserAccessTokenJpaRepositoryCustom
Repository of the personal access tokens and of the tokens issued to OAuth clients. A token is found by the SHA-256 hash of its clear text, which the unique index on token_hash turns into a single index lookup per authenticated request. The token kind is passed as the byte value of AccessTokenKind.

    • lockByTokenHash

      @Lock(PESSIMISTIC_WRITE) @Query("SELECT t FROM UserAccessToken t WHERE t.tokenHash = ?1") Optional<UserAccessToken> lockByTokenHash(String tokenHash)
      Loads a token by its hash and locks its row until the end of the transaction, so that a refresh token is consumed exactly once even when a client sends it twice at the same time.

    • deletePersonalToken

      @Transactional @Modifying @Query("DELETE FROM UserAccessToken t WHERE t.idUser = ?1 AND t.idUserAccessToken = ?2 AND t.tokenKind = 1") int deletePersonalToken(Integer idUser, Integer idUserAccessToken)
      Revokes a personal token by deleting it, but only when it belongs to the given user. Tokens of an OAuth client are revoked through their family.
      Parameters:
      idUser - the owner
      idUserAccessToken - the token to revoke
      Returns:
      the number of deleted rows, 0 when the token does not exist, belongs to someone else or is no personal token

    • deleteExpiredAccessTokensOfFamily

      @Transactional @Modifying @Query("DELETE FROM UserAccessToken t WHERE t.idOAuthAuthorization = ?1 AND t.tokenKind = 2 AND t.expiresAt < ?2") int deleteExpiredAccessTokensOfFamily(Integer idOAuthAuthorization, LocalDateTime nowUtc)

    • deleteConsumedBeyond

      @Transactional @Modifying @Query(nativeQuery=true) int deleteConsumedBeyond(Integer idOAuthAuthorization, int keep)
      Keeps only the most recently consumed refresh tokens of an OAuth family. They stay recognizable so that a replay revokes the family; older ones are deleted in the same transaction as the rotation that consumed the newest. Named query: UserAccessToken.deleteConsumedBeyond
      Parameters:
      idOAuthAuthorization - the family
      keep - how many consumed refresh tokens remain, the newest by consumption time and id
      Returns:
      the number of deleted tokens

    • updateLastUsedAt

      @Transactional @Modifying @Query("UPDATE UserAccessToken t SET t.lastUsedAt = ?2\nWHERE t.idUserAccessToken = ?1 AND (t.lastUsedAt IS NULL OR t.lastUsedAt < ?3)") int updateLastUsedAt(Integer idUserAccessToken, LocalDateTime nowUtc, LocalDateTime notAfterUtc)
      Records the use of a token. The condition on the stored value makes the write happen at most once per hour, even when several requests of the same token arrive at the same time.
      Parameters:
      idUserAccessToken - the token that was used
      nowUtc - the time of use in UTC
      notAfterUtc - the stored value must be older than this, normally one hour before nowUtc
      Returns:
      1 when the time of use was written, otherwise 0

    • deleteExpiredBefore

      @Transactional @Modifying @Query("DELETE FROM UserAccessToken t WHERE t.tokenKind = 1 AND t.expiresAt < ?1") int deleteExpiredBefore(LocalDateTime expiredBeforeUtc)
      Deletes the personal tokens whose expiry lies before the given time. Expired tokens stay visible in the dialog for a while, so the purge task passes a time 30 days in the past.
      Parameters:
      expiredBeforeUtc - personal tokens that expired before this UTC time are deleted
      Returns:
      the number of deleted tokens

    • deleteExpiredOAuthTokens

      @Transactional @Modifying @Query("DELETE FROM UserAccessToken t WHERE t.tokenKind <> 1 AND t.consumedAt IS NULL AND t.expiresAt < ?1") int deleteExpiredOAuthTokens(LocalDateTime nowUtc)
      Deletes the expired OAuth tokens that were never consumed. A consumed refresh token stays until its family ends, because only then can a replay of it no longer occur.
      Parameters:
      nowUtc - the current UTC time
      Returns:
      the number of deleted tokens
